metadata.description: Nova-Violet Role: RoT DtD Commander, the creator kit. Claude Code commands, skills and agents with a declared DTD grammar and trust boundary; creators for prompts, skills, hooks, commands, subagents, plans, MCP servers, workflows, tasks, filetypes and dorks; the Adiutor Stop-hook doctor and the Commander-Adiutor monitor, run by hand unless armed.

plugins.name: rot-dtd-commander
plugins.description: 123 -dtd commands (the nine RoT MoE lenses and ELEVATE among them, nineteen book-derived commands with their voice profiles, sixteen prompt creators over eight schematics, the tasks family, the filetype and dork creators), 22 skills, 5 agents; the Adiutor: a Stop hook that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE of the command that produced it, a ledger, and the /RoT-DtD-Commander-Adiutor doctor; and the Commander-Adiutor: a monitor that hands every failed answer to the session as the ledger closes it. Nothing is armed by a plain install; rdc install --arm or rdc arm arms the hooks, rdc watch starts the monitor, each under a 300 second ceiling. Armed, the AI_SLOP gate judges every answer, file, commit message and request body before it lands, and /deep-scratch-dtd builds in a git worktree behind a merge gate (5.1.0). 5.2.0 adds the codebase growth family: /amplify-codebase-dtd, /enhance-codebase-dtd and /overhaul-codebase-dtd walk any codebase, expose what could be done as measured gaps and reasoned ideas on a fifteen-verb ladder, remember every refusal between runs, and name the release the kept work amounts to without taking it. 6.0.0 makes the version itself measured: a release names the verbs it kept in a state record, the recognizer turns them into a number, and a manifest that says anything else is refused by name.
